set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

secret [parameter2].explanation: Configure IP addresses and shared keys for RADIGUS servers.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

authentication-port [parameter2].explanation: Configure the authentication port for the RADIGUS server.

accounting-port [parameter2].explanation: Configure the billing port for the RADIGUS server.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system login user [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

authentication plain-text-password [para.explanation: Configure the system login user's authentication as an explicit password.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet.explanation: Configure interfaces to support IPv4 protocol communities.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

encapsulation [parameter3].explanation: Configure the envelope type of the interface.

vlan-id [parameter3].explanation: Configure VLAN IDs for interface units.

parameters.name: vlan-id
parameters.explanation: VLAN ID, used to identify VLAN.

set services l2tp remote-access tunnel p.template: set services l2tp remote-access tunnel password [parameter1]
set services l2tp remote-access tunnel p.command: set services l2tp remote-access tunnel password "072A5C090A504B5D5F131D0F0C"
set services l2tp remote-access tunnel p.explanation: Configures the password for L2TP remote access to tunnels.

set services l2tp remote-access authenti.command: set services l2tp remote-access authentication chap
set services l2tp remote-access authenti.explanation: Configures the authentication of L2TP remote access to CHAP.

set services l2tp remote-access client p.template: set services l2tp remote-access client pool low [parameter1]
set services l2tp remote-access client p.command: set services l2tp remote-access client pool low 10.38.160.1
set services l2tp remote-access client p.explanation: The command sets the lower bound of the IP address pool for L2TP remote-access clients to the value specified by `[parameter1]`.

high [parameter2].explanation: The command `high [parameter2]` in Junos sets the high threshold value for a specific parameter (e.g., queue depth, buffer usage) to trigger an alert or action.

set services l2tp remote-access client b.template: set services l2tp remote-access client bind-address [parameter1]
set services l2tp remote-access client b.command: set services l2tp remote-access client bind-address 10.38.160.1
set services l2tp remote-access client b.explanation: Configures L2TP remote access to the bound address of the client.
